scene.name: papers/c3_balloon_keepup

task.name: papers
task.sentence: Keep the balloon in the air with the paddle.
task.protocol: One balloon, held until a hand is raised under it; the episode ends once it has been aloft 60 s after its release, when it touches the floor or rests on anything for 1 s, or at the task's cap of 300 s.
task.pass_rule: Passed when the balloon has stayed aloft 60 s after its release (held the task's 1 s) without touching the floor or resting on anything for 1 s.

scene.description: Sprout stands in a party room with a big red balloon hanging in the air in front of it, over a light round paddle on a stand whose handle lies between the open fingers of its right hand; the balloon is let go as soon as a hand is raised under it -- keep it in the air (tap it up with the paddle, or with your hands). Aids -- the balloon's and the paddle's poses come from an external tracker; the closed jaws latch the paddle's handle.
